gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans keeps its letters open and friendly, drawn as smooth tubes that never clog into blots. And Shantell Sans sits above it with a wide-mouthed, marker-like swagger, so a long page would feel relaxed and easy going.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bai-jamjuree: Loose, hand-drawn fun up top in Shantell Sans, then a body that stays light and unpinched, with rounded letters and no swelling strokes at all. Bai Jamjuree reads smoothly down a page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-barlow: Shantell Sans draws every letter with one fixed nib width and a mouth that gapes like a cut tin can. Barlow, a tidy sans with neon-tube strokes, is where it feels most at home.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-biz-udgothic: Marker-fresh and a bit cheeky, Shantell Sans keeps its line unvarying from letter to letter. And BIZ UDGothic is the strongest partner here, a modern sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-biz-udpgothic: Shantell Sans is built from one constant stroke, with a mouth wide as a cut tin can. And it earns its keep big and short, while BIZ UDPGothic stays out of its way.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bpmf-huninn: Shantell Sans brings expressive, fixed-nib letters with wide open mouths to the top of the page. Bpmf Huninn then takes the text, a modern sans with a single-weight outline feel, and gives it a little extra size.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Shantell Sans draws every letter with a flat, unvarying line. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std adds a slight tug of heavier verticals against lighter horizontals, so a long page feels gently lively without ever getting fussy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cairo: Cairo reads modern and businesslike, with a wide channel into every bowl, while Shantell Sans brings curves as heavy as cord. Paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cairo-play: Expressive from the first letter, Shantell Sans holds a steady pen pressure all the way across. Cairo Play sits beside it as a plain sans with open round letters, tidy and modern against all that handwriting.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cambay: Cut-vinyl charm, that's Shantell Sans, with every line at a single width. And Cambay, a contemporary sans-serif whose rounds gap like a cracked bangle, would carry a long page with a light touch.
